## Decisions
- Follow Premiere's three-point-editing model throughout (not Resolve/FCP) — matches existing mark-key choices (`I`/`O`/`X`/`/`/`;`/`'`) already shipped. See plan file's comparison table.
- No dual side-by-side monitor in this feature; Program/Source stay tabs of one `MonitorPane`.
- No Fit Clip dialog for 4-point edits — source Out is ignored with a status note; Fit to Fill is a separate phase-6 command instead.
- Targeting toggle implemented as its own `V1`/`A1` chip, not a click on the track name (departure from the original plan text, logged in the DONE entry) — keeps rename's existing double-click-on-name gesture intact.
- Bin drops will start overwriting instead of overlapping once phase 4 lands — a deliberate, called-out behavior change to existing shipped functionality.
